title: SEO WATCHERS + DEMAND SIGNALS. SEO is inside us now — we sing and pollinate OUT. But do we have watchers? Do we know when our images appear in Google Images? Do we know what demand systems exist? LIVE DATA: 517K requests/day, 17K unique visitors, but 239K 404s (46%!). We need demand watchers, image search monitors, and signal feedback loops.

the_live_data.source: cf-arterial.json on golgi (Cloudflare analytics ? golgi CNS)

404.diagnosis: NEARLY HALF of all requests are 404s. visitors and fleet looking for things that DON'T EXIST. these 404s ARE the demand signal. what are they looking for?

200.diagnosis: less than a third of requests find what they want.

403.diagnosis: forbidden. blocked. the immune system is rejecting. is it rejecting things it should let through?

today_2026_10_26_partial.note: partial day (~3.5 hours). on pace for ~700K/day.

1_demand_watcher.what: monitor the 404 logs to see WHAT people are searching for that we don't have
1_demand_watcher.how: parse Caddy access.json logs on golgi for 404 paths. group by path. rank by frequency.
1_demand_watcher.output: a demand signal feed: 'visitors want X but we don't have it. here are the top 20 missing things.'
1_demand_watcher.action: either CREATE the missing content (grow a new leaf) or REDIRECT to the nearest existing content (mycelial routing)
1_demand_watcher.frequency: daily. the demand signal changes. today's 404s = tomorrow's new pages.
1_demand_watcher.the_insight: 239K 404s is NOT a bug. it's 239K DEMAND SIGNALS. each 404 is someone LOOKING for something. that's pollen. we need to catch it.

2_image_search_watcher.what: monitor Google Images, Bing Images, and other image search engines for our content
how: Google Search Console (GSC) — if configured, shows which queries surface our images
Bing Webmaster Tools — same for Bing
Manual spot checks — search for key terms and see if our images appear
Reverse image search — upload our key images and see where they're showing up
what_to_watch_for: our spore print art appearing in image searches
our artisan collaboration pieces showing up
our chromatic body diagrams being found
any image from primals.eco appearing anywhere
2_image_search_watcher.current_state: UNKNOWN. we have NO image search monitoring. we don't know if ANY of our images appear in Google Images.
2_image_search_watcher.critical_issue: we don't have dedicated OG/social images yet (og-sporeprint.png doesn't exist). Google Images indexes tags, not OG tags. we need to check what images ARE being indexed from our HTML pages.

3_pollen_tracker.what: track when our content is shared, linked, cited, or referenced externally
how: backlink monitoring — who links TO primals.eco from outside
social mention tracking — who shares our URLs on Twitter/X, Reddit, HN, etc.
citation tracking — who cites our research/papers
RSS subscriber count — who subscribes to our feed
3_pollen_tracker.why: we sing and pollinate OUT. but we don't know if the pollen LANDS. the pollen tracker tells us: did the bee carry it? did the flower receive it? did the seed grow?

4_serp_position_watcher.what: track our position in search engine results pages (SERPs) for key terms
4_serp_position_watcher.how: Google Search Console provides this for free. also: manual SERP checks, rank tracking tools.
4_serp_position_watcher.current_state: UNKNOWN. do we rank for ANYTHING? we have no idea.

5_competitor_demand_scanner.what: look at what people are searching for in our space and see if we have content that matches
5_competitor_demand_scanner.how: keyword research tools, Google Trends, 'People also ask' mining, Reddit/HN thread scanning
5_competitor_demand_scanner.action: match demand to our existing content. we have 1043 files. many of them probably match search demand we don't know about.

the_math.meaning: NEARLY HALF of all visitors are looking for something we HAVE (conceptually) but haven't SERVED (as a page). the content exists in our JSON files but not as HTML pages.
the_math.the_gap: 1043 data files. 678 HTML pages. but 239K requests hit nothing. the mycelium is rich but the leaves are thin.

the_404_is_the_demand_signal.action: parse the 404 paths. find the top 100 missing URLs. for each: does a JSON file exist that answers this? if yes: generate an HTML page. the truffle pig finds the data, the porcupine pins the page.

immediate_execution.1: pull 404 log analysis from golgi to see top missing paths
immediate_execution.2: check if Google Search Console is configured for primals.eco
immediate_execution.3: add image alt tags to all elements (Google Images indexes alt text)
immediate_execution.4: generate og-sporeprint.png (still critical — without it, no social cards work)
immediate_execution.5: add structured data (JSON-LD) with ImageObject schema for key images
